name: agent-readiness
description: Score how AI-ready a code repository, monorepo, or multi-repo workspace is and surface the fixes as paste-ready prompts — entirely in chat, no browser or dashboard. Wraps the headless agent-readiness-mcp server (>=0.9.0). Always calls inspect_tool first, then exactly one headless scan tool (scan_repo_tool / scan_monorepo_tool / scan_workspace_tool(path, children)) which returns the readiness report inline. Presents the score plus the engine's generated fix_prompts, leading with the workspace Coordination prompts.
